reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Tennessee
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for substantial damage to property?
    Interpreted as: if tenant adequately cures a remediable "damage beyond normal wear and tear"
    breach within the statutory cure period (and satisfies any statutory prerequisites), may the
    landlord still terminate for that breach?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic helpers (pure, deterministic where possible)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

is_yes(yes).
is_no(no).

% safer integer comparison wrapper
within_days(DaysAfterReceipt, Limit) :-
    integer(DaysAfterReceipt),
    integer(Limit),
    DaysAfterReceipt >= 0,
    DaysAfterReceipt =< Limit.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Parties
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).

% Jurisdiction / regime facts
state(tennessee).
focus_year(2021).

% Whether county is governed by the Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (URLTA)
% (TN Code  66-7-109 says it does not apply in URLTA counties.)
urlta_county_applies(yes).

% Residential tenancy and rental period
residential_tenancy(tenant1, landlord1).
rental_period_days(tenant1, 30).

% The breach: "substantial damage to property" -> damage beyond normal wear and tear
breach_type(tenant1, damage_beyond_normal_wear_and_tear).

% Whether the breach is remediable by repairs/payment (statutes condition cure on remediability)
breach_remediable(tenant1, yes).

% Landlord served written notice of termination / noncompliance and tenant received it.
notice_received(tenant1, notice1).
notice_reason(notice1, damage_beyond_normal_wear_and_tear).
notice_is_written(notice1, yes).

% Tenant attempts to cure and does so within 14 days after receipt.
tenant_remedied_breach(tenant1, yes).
days_after_notice_when_remedied(tenant1, 10).

% URLTA prerequisite for tenant-performed repairs:
% Tenant requested repairs in writing and landlord authorized in writing before repairs were made.
tenant_requested_repairs_in_writing(tenant1, yes).
landlord_authorized_repairs_in_writing(landlord1, tenant1, yes).

% No repeat breach within 6 months (so the "repeat breach" shorter-notice rule doesn't apply).
repeat_same_breach_within_6_months(tenant1, no).

/* Helper predicate summarizing the encoded factual statement for reuse. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(tennessee),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(L),
    tenant(T),
    residential_tenancy(T, L),
    breach_type(T, damage_beyond_normal_wear_and_tear),
    breach_remediable(T, yes),
    notice_received(T, N),
    notice_is_written(N, yes),
    notice_reason(N, damage_beyond_normal_wear_and_tear),
    tenant_remedied_breach(T, yes),
    days_after_notice_when_remedied(T, D),
    integer(D),
    D >= 0.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute encodings (deterministic predicates capturing the statutes)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
   TN Code  66-7-109 (2021) (non-URLTA counties; excluded in URLTA counties)
   - 14 days' notice sufficient for termination for:
     (A) nonpayment of rent in arrears; (B) damage beyond normal wear and tear; (C) violent act/danger.
   - If notice given for (A) or (B) AND breach is remediable AND tenant adequately remedies before
     the date in the notice, the rental agreement will not terminate.
*/
statute_66_7_109_applies(Tenant) :-
    residential_tenancy(Tenant, _Landlord),
    rental_period_days(Tenant, Days),
    integer(Days),
    Days >= 14,
    urlta_county_applies(no).

statute_66_7_109_covered_reason(nonpayment_of_rent_in_arrears).
statute_66_7_109_covered_reason(damage_beyond_normal_wear_and_tear).
statute_66_7_109_covered_reason(violent_act_or_real_present_danger).

% Cure prevents termination for covered reasons (A) or (B), when remediable and adequately cured in time.
% We treat "adequately remedies prior to the date specified in the notice" as "remedied within 14 days"
% for this program's timeline model.
statute_66_7_109_cure_prevents_termination(Tenant) :-
    statute_66_7_109_applies(Tenant),
    notice_received(Tenant, Notice),
    notice_reason(Notice, Reason),
    ( Reason = nonpayment_of_rent_in_arrears
    ; Reason = damage_beyond_normal_wear_and_tear
    ),
    breach_remediable(Tenant, yes),
    tenant_remedied_breach(Tenant, yes),
    days_after_notice_when_remedied(Tenant, DaysAfterReceipt),
    within_days(DaysAfterReceipt, 14).

/*
   TN Code  66-28-505 (2021) (URLTA)
   If material noncompliance is remediable by payment of rent / cost of repairs / damages / other amount:
   - landlord may give notice that if not remedied within 14 days after receipt, agreement terminates.
   - Repairs by the tenant must be requested in writing and authorized in writing by landlord prior.
*/
statute_66_28_505_applies(Tenant) :-
    residential_tenancy(Tenant, _Landlord),
    urlta_county_applies(yes).

statute_66_28_505_cure_period_days(14).

% Encodes the authorization prerequisite for tenant-performed repairs under  66-28-505(a)(2)(A).
statute_66_28_505_repairs_authorized_prereq_satisfied(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    tenant_requested_repairs_in_writing(Tenant, yes),
    landlord_authorized_repairs_in_writing(Landlord, Tenant, yes).

% Cure is effective under  66-28-505(a)(2) when remediable, cured in 14 days, and repair prereq met.
statute_66_28_505_effective_cure_prevents_termination(Tenant) :-
    statute_66_28_505_applies(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    residential_tenancy(Tenant, Landlord),
    breach_remediable(Tenant, yes),
    tenant_remedied_breach(Tenant, yes),
    days_after_notice_when_remedied(Tenant, DaysAfterReceipt),
    statute_66_28_505_cure_period_days(Limit),
    within_days(DaysAfterReceipt, Limit),
    statute_66_28_505_repairs_authorized_prereq_satisfied(Landlord, Tenant).

/*
   TN Code  66-28-508 (2021)
   If landlord accepts rent without reservation and with knowledge of a default, landlord waives
   right to terminate as to that breach.
   (Not necessary to answer this scenario, but encoded as requested.)
*/
statute_66_28_508_acceptance_waives_termination(Tenant) :-
    statute_66_28_505_applies(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    residential_tenancy(Tenant, Landlord),
    landlord_accepted_rent_without_reservation_with_knowledge_of_default(Landlord, Tenant, yes).

% Scenario does NOT include rent acceptance; set as "no" to keep model complete/deterministic.
landlord_accepted_rent_without_reservation_with_knowledge_of_default(_Landlord, _Tenant, no).

/*
   TN Code  66-28-506 (2021)
   If tenant noncompliance affecting health/safety can be remedied by repair/cleaning and tenant fails
   to comply within 14 days after notice, landlord may enter and do work and bill as rent.
   (Not directly needed for this question; included for completeness.)
*/
statute_66_28_506_landlord_may_repair_and_bill(Tenant) :-
    statute_66_28_505_applies(Tenant),
    noncompliance_materially_affecting_health_and_safety(Tenant, yes),
    noncompliance_remediable_by_repair_or_cleaning(Tenant, yes),
    tenant_failed_to_remedy_within_14_days_after_notice(Tenant, yes).

% Scenario does not involve health/safety noncompliance
noncompliance_materially_affecting_health_and_safety(_Tenant, no).
noncompliance_remediable_by_repair_or_cleaning(_Tenant, no).
tenant_failed_to_remedy_within_14_days_after_notice(_Tenant, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: "Must landlord accept tenant's attempt to cure?"
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% In this program, "landlord must accept cure" means:
%   the landlord may NOT terminate the rental agreement for the cited damage breach because
%   the tenant made an effective statutory cure in time (or landlord waived termination).
landlord_must_accept_cure(Tenant) :-
    scenario_statement,
    (   statute_66_28_505_effective_cure_prevents_termination(Tenant)
    ;   statute_66_7_109_cure_prevents_termination(Tenant)
    ;   statute_66_28_508_acceptance_waives_termination(Tenant)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    tenant(T),
    landlord_must_accept_cure(T),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for substantial damage to property?
